title: A view that extends a refined view inherits the refinement
rule: A view that extends another view inherits that view's refinements in the same model.

provisional.question: The documentation does not say whether extends copies a view before or after its refinements are applied.

citations.quote: With LookML refinements, you can adapt an existing view or Explore without editing the LookML file that contains it.
If there are any conflicts, the extending object will take precedence and override the settings of the object that is being extended.
